thread:
dana: Vendor (Acme EU) pinging — they received a EUR payment yesterday but our accounting system didn't get a remit/PO. Amount matches invoice but bank reference is truncated. Vendor attached their bank confirmation PDF. Can payments ops help trace?

michael: Got the vendor PDF? Can you paste the payment value date, amount, and the reference string shown on the bank confirmation? Also last 4 of our receiving IBAN if present.

dana: Uploaded screenshot. Details: value date 2026-03-14, amount EUR 54,320.00, beneficiary IBAN ends ...2491, payer BIC CHASDEFFXXX, reference field shows "ACME INV 2024-INV-4123 CHASNLC" — looks truncated. Vendor says they need PO #9987 to apply payment; our PO system shows PO 9987 for that invoice.

anya: If the bank omitted the PO in the payment text, we can't auto-apply. Vendor will hold the invoice if PO isn't confirmed. We can temporarily credit them but need proof of funds for audit.

michael: Likely the middle/forwarding bank clipped the remittance. Action: request full MT103 / SWIFT copy from our bank so we can see the untruncated ordering info and any ordering/ultimate beneficiary fields. I'll open an investigation.

ops-bot: Ticket created: FIN-8763 — Payments investigation (assigned to michael). ETA 24-48h for bank response. :white_check_mark: 

michael: Drafting email to bank ops now. Will ask for: full MT103, payment trace number, value date, ordering customer name, ordering customer account, all unstructured remittance fields, and any intermediate bank details. Use this template when requesting from bank:

```
To: payments.ops@bank.com
Subject: URGENT: Request for full MT103 / SWIFT copy — trace and remittance details

We require the full SWIFT MT103 for incoming credit to our account. Details below:
- Amount: EUR 54,320.00
- Value date: 14 Mar 2026
- Ordering bank BIC: CHASDEFFXXX
- Beneficiary IBAN (masked): ****2491
- Our account: 123456789 / Redwood Inference Ltd
- Bank reference observed: "ACME INV 2024-INV-4123 CHASNLC" (truncated)

Please provide: the MT103 message text (fields 50a/50, 59, 70), the bank's trace/reference (if any), and any intermediate bank (56a/57a) fields. This is needed for vendor reconciliation and PO matching.

Kind regards,
Payments Ops / Redwood Inference
```

michael: Also asked bank to run an "investigation/trace" to see whether the ordering customer populated a different remittance block that got lost on routing. If they can provide a full MT103 PDF we can forward to vendor as proof.

dana: Vendor (Paul) replied in thread: they can accept MT103 or a bank-signed confirmation with the ordering reference and unstructured remittance (the PO). They flagged this as urgent since they have a manual hold on deliveries.

paul_acme: Confirmed — we will accept MT103 copy or scanned SWIFT copy. Please escalate, otherwise we will start credit hold policy tomorrow morning.

anya: For audit, if bank won't provide MT103 quickly, we can temporarily apply payment against the invoice after dual approval (finance manager + payments ops) given matching amount/date and vendor confirmation. Need a written note in the vendor portal and a comment on the invoice.

michael: I'll call the bank ops desk now (phone queue open) and escalate to SWIFT team. Logging actions in FIN-8763. If the bank can only provide a trace id, ask them to include the ordering customer name/acc in the trace.

michael: Follow-up 2h later — bank acknowledged and forwarded to SWIFT investigations. They gave a reference: SWIFT-INV-20260314-99123. Expect response within 48h.

dana: Thanks. I've added a temporary credit-hold override note on the vendor portal and messaged the customer success rep. Vendor confirmed they will hold releases for 24h pending the MT103.

paul_acme: Thanks everyone — we'll standby for the MT103 copy or bank confirmation.

michael: Next steps: (1) wait for SWIFT copy / MT103 from bank, (2) if received, forward to vendor and auto-apply PO, (3) if not received in 48h, finance to approve temporary application with documented proof (vendor confirmation + bank trace). I'll update FIN-8763 as things progress.

dana: Great — closing Slack thread for now. Please update ticket and vendor portal when resolved. :pray:
